summary: SNDL Inc. filed a Form 6-K incorporating a notice of annual and special meeting dated September 3, 2026, and held virtually on October 15, 2026. The special resolution seeks shareholder approval for a share consolidation of common shares at a ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-10, expected to be implemented by the board before October 31, 2026 or within one year. The meeting also covers routine items: financial statements, fixing board size at five, election of directors, and appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as auditor. Kingsdale Advisors provides proxy solicitation services. Approval requires a special resolution.
